resources.string: Android Pro
One-time purchase. Support ongoing development.
A one-time Pro purchase supports ongoing development of NovaScale and unlocks the features below. No subscription.
Open source
NovaScale for Android is open source. You are welcome to fork the code, change or remove the limits, and build your own version.
Community edition
All local features are included in this open-source build.
No purchase required.
Additional tailnets
Save more networks. Keep one active at a time.
Unlimited custom groups
Organize your hosts however you like.
Unlimited daily Herdr visits
Start remote visits throughout the day.
The free plan includes one saved tailnet.
The free plan includes three custom host groups.
The free plan includes three Herdr visits each day. Existing visits can continue.
